Answers to all 10 are below. Where a question was open to interpretation, I note my reading.

- **Q1:** Only one departed shipment carries this SKU.
- **Q2:** Five NBBW POs have a later ETD than the first one recorded. PO-2026-0024 has only one ETD, so it is excluded.
- **Q3:** The store's `as_of` reads when facts were loaded, and everything was loaded on 2 Oct 2026. So I rebuilt the position from history, taking each value from the latest source document issued before 1 July 2026.
- **Q4:** Entries filed 1 April to 30 June 2026 inclusive.
- **Q5:** Inspections dated in 2026.
- **Q7:** I used each supplier's currency from its supplier record. YWLX is in CNY and the rest are in USD.
- **Q8:** The person has 3 accounts with 6 orders between them, after following the `core/same_as` links to the account they all duplicate.
- **Q9:** The time is when the store committed the transaction, 2026-10-02 18:50:23 UTC. The source document behind it was issued on 2026-09-11.
- **Q10:** Only YWLX makes this SKU. Its in-production PO has no shipped units, so 1560 units are at the factory. The 2520 units on the water are on a shipped PO.
